_meta.note: KAS 0.66.62 (the @kiro/agent package.json kiro-cli 2.34.0 installs) reached through `kiro-cli acp --agent-engine v3 --auth-method cli`, the production relay spawn, driven over stdio by a scratch client under an isolated HOME (no host agents, steering or mcp.json reached the wire). Agent-to-client lines verbatim and in order, except: the session id is replaced with a fixed synthetic value, every engine-minted tool-call id with a numbered synthetic one, the scratch work dir reads as /work. Frames omitted as host inventory: _kiro/mcp/status, _kiro/powers/items_changed, _kiro/steering/documents_changed, _kiro/sessions/changed, _kiro/governance/state, _kiro/progressive_context/items_changed, _kiro/policy/changed, available_commands_update, config_option_update, session_info_update, user_message_chunk, agent_thought_chunk, and every _kiro/tools/didChange but the last of each run (the one that follows a session/set_mode and lists the bound agent's tool tags). The initialize result drops its `logging` paths; session/new and session/load results are TRIMMED to sessionId, modes.currentModeId and the probe's own availableModes entry. KAS's initialize carries no agentInfo, so no agent name is recorded. The agent `probe-mcp` was sent as _meta.kiro.customAgents with tools [@probe-<x>] and mcpServers {probe-<x>: a stdio echo server whose one tool probe_<x>_echo answers <X>-ECHO:<text>}. Scenario: session/new registers servers {A, B}; set_mode; turn 1 asks the model to remember SAFFRON and call probe_b_echo (B-ECHO:one). Then session/close, session/load of the SAME session id carrying customAgents {A} only, and set_mode: the load replays turn 1, the didChange after set_mode lists @probe-a only, and turn 2's attempt to call probe_b_echo fails (Tool Call failed), the model says NO-TOOL-B and recalls SAFFRON. The withdrawn server's tools are gone at the next turn with the transcript intact.
